whenToUse: A booking agenda by day: meeting rooms, visitors and extras with a now line.
Front desks checking in, confirming or cancelling bookings with undo.
avoidWhen: A time-grid of resources side by side — use resource-calendar.
a11y: Each day is a labelled section; booking changes are reported in a role="status" live region.
Rooms are colour-coded — keep room names as text on every booking.
